runners_data.name: Ka Mate Du Brivet
runners_data.note: Natural front runner who should dictate terms unopposed but needs to prove stamina over this extended trip.

runners_data.name: Broomfield Aderra
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent racer with strong recent good ground form who should track the leader perfectly.

runners_data.name: Willshebe Court
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer whose style relies on a strong pace to be effective but form figures remain unclear.

races.paceDynamic: Ka Mate Du Brivet will dictate terms as the lone front runner, likely setting a steady tempo without pressure early on. With Broomfield Aderra sitting prominent and Willshebe Court held up, the pace should be manageable through the early stages before quickening significantly from the final turn as the hold-up horse makes his challenge.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Ka Mate Du Brivet jumps cleanly and maintains rhythm
scenarios.body: The leader controls fractions without interference, building momentum through hurdles while the others struggle to close the gap. His sustainable galloping style proves decisive over this staying trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Broomfield Aderra travels strongly in behind the leader
scenarios.body: The winner sits perfectly positioned to strike turning for home, using superior recent form to overhaul a tiring Ka Mate Du Brivet. His consistent recent performances on good ground prove crucial.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong early or Ka Mate Du Brivet goes too fast
scenarios.body: Willshebe Court benefits from a strong gallop that sets up his closing kick, sweeping past tired leaders in the final furlong. The hold-up style thrives when others have gone too hard.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Jumping Carnage
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses make significant jumping errors at key hurdles
scenarios.body: The race falls apart tactically with mistakes disrupting rhythm and positioning, allowing an unexpected winner to emerge. Whichever horse maintains fluency through the obstacles capitalizes on others' misfortunes.

watchPoints.text: Ka Mate Du Brivet could face stamina questions if he sets too strong a pace in the early stages
Broomfield Aderra's jumping fluency will be crucial when asked to quicken after the final hurdle
Willshebe Court needs the other two to go fast enough early to bring his finishing kick into play
The small field size reduces tactical options and increases the importance of clean jumping throughout
Any significant jumping error by Ka Mate Du Brivet would completely change the complexion of the race

races.paceDynamic: Motazzen as the sole confirmed leader will dictate terms from the front, likely setting a sustainable gallop without pressure through the early stages. With multiple hold-up horses (Geordies Betty, Godot, Wot You Wearing) and prominent runners (Peking Opera, Vendant, Kylenoe Dancer) sitting behind, this creates a classic front-runner versus closers dynamic where the pace judgement and final-furlong finishing kick will be crucial.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Motazzen Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Motazzen gets an uncontested lead and judges the pace perfectly
scenarios.body: The front-runner builds an unassailable advantage through controlled fractions, with the hold-up horses unable to reel him in. Peking Opera and Vendant may get closest but fall short of the winner.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too strong early or Motazzen weakens turning for home
scenarios.body: Geordies Betty and Godot benefit from their patient tactics as the leaders fade, with one of the higher-rated closers timing their run to perfection. The race becomes a battle between the strongest finishers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the race develops into a true test where tracking the leader pays dividends
scenarios.body: Peking Opera or Vendant get the perfect trip tracking Motazzen before striking in the final half-mile. The hold-up horses struggle to make up sufficient ground from their patient positions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Kylenoe Dancer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the race unfolds at a steady pace allowing all horses to remain competitive turning in
scenarios.body: Kylenoe Dancer's recent Fontwell win gives confidence and the horse finds improvement when others disappoint. The even pace allows this lower-rated runner to outfinish more fancied rivals.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Motazzen gets pressured early by Peking Opera or Vendant as this will compromise his finishing kick
Monitor Godot's jumping as hold-up horses need clean rounds to make up ground in closing stages
Observe Kylenoe Dancer's position turning in as recent winner may have found improvement
Check if Geordies Betty gets clear run approaching last as hold-up horses need racing room
Watch for any early mistakes from Wot You Wearing as lowest-rated needs everything to go right

races.paceDynamic: Ronnies Reflection, Tom Desjy, Daring Plan, Valirann Gold and Engaging Sam will all show early speed, creating a moderate to strong pace from the outset. With five prominent runners and only two hold-up horses (Kitsilano and Royal Juniper), the pace will be honest throughout but not suicidal. This should set up well for the closers if the pace-setters don't settle properly.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the five prominent runners fail to settle and go too fast early
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainable over this trip on soft ground, causing the leaders to weaken markedly from 3 out. Kitsilano and Royal Juniper benefit from the strong pace and pick up the pieces late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Moderate Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Ronnies Reflection and Valirann Gold lead sensibly without pressure
scenarios.body: The pace is honest but sustainable, allowing the prominent runners to maintain their positions throughout. The race becomes a sprint from the last fence with stamina and class deciding.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Ronnies Reflection gets an easy lead and dictates throughout
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too slow for the hold-up horses to be effective, with Ronnies Reflection able to quicken clear from 2 out. Tom Desjy and Valirann Gold track the leader but cannot match the kick.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Grind
scenarios.trigger: If the soft ground and trip create a true staying test from early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a war of attrition with several runners struggling to see out the trip on testing ground. Only the most genuine stayers survive, with fitness and stamina trumping class.

watchPoints.text: Tom Desjy's tendency to fade in the finish could be exaggerated over this longer trip
Royal Juniper needs the pace to be strong early to be competitive from hold-up position
Kitsilano's jumping quality under pressure given the likely competitive pace scenario
Ronnies Reflection's ability to sustain pace if pressured early by multiple prominent runners
Valirann Gold's stamina reserves after winning last time out over shorter distance

scenarios.title: Steady Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Last Round maintains an even gallop and the prominent quartet don't interfere with each other
scenarios.body: The race develops into a tactical affair where those on the pace have positional advantage. Hold-up horses struggle to make ground in the testing conditions.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.label: C

scenarios.body: The leader weakens entering the straight and the hold-up horses get perfect conditions to unleash late runs. The Quant and Khalk'eau Spigao time their challenges perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Unknown Entity Powers Through
scenarios.trigger: If Unknown Entity avoids the traffic and gets a clean run through on soft ground he clearly handles

races.paceDynamic: The Gypsy Davey will lead uncontested with Mon Champion, Superstylin, Koenigsstern and Le Galli Bier forming the early prominent group behind. This creates a sustainable gallop that will set up perfectly for the hold-up horses Alien Storm, Alright Dai and Rip Wheeler to time their challenges from the back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained gallop setup
scenarios.trigger: If The Gypsy Davey maintains an even tempo without serious early pressure from the prominent pack.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a stamina test where tactical positioning matters more than early speed. The patient hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent group pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Mon Champion and Superstylin take the race to The Gypsy Davey from halfway, creating genuine pace pressure.
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and eliminates some finishers but plays into the hands of horses with tactical speed. Late runners need to be closer than usual to have any impact.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Early leader dominance
scenarios.trigger: If The Gypsy Davey gets such an easy lead that he's still full of running turning for home.
scenarios.body: The lack of pace allows the leader to kick clear before the hold-up horses can organize their challenges. Prominent runners struggle to bridge the gap to a revitalized leader.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy pace collapse
scenarios.trigger: If The Gypsy Davey stops quickly or there's interference in the prominent group, creating a stop-start gallop.
scenarios.body: The race becomes scrappy with no clear rhythm, favoring horses that can quicken from any position rather than pure hold-up types. Form figures become less reliable in the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Monitor if Mon Champion or Superstylin take the race to The Gypsy Davey early as this could set up a different tactical scenario.
